name: Daniel Morgan Oates
alt: Portrait of Daniel Morgan Oates outdoors in a green jacket
bio: Daniel began landscape gardening while still at school and grew up in Herefordshire. He studied at Pershore College, worked in West London, and went on to found Morgan Oates.
He leads hard and soft landscaping, and is the person most clients deal with on site.

name: Anna Pawlowska
alt: Portrait of Anna Pawlowska wearing glasses, holding orange flowers
bio: Anna holds a master’s degree in landscape architecture from the University of Warmia and Mazury in Poland, and has studied on scholarships in Hungary, Portugal and Ukraine.

She joined Morgan Oates in 2013, moving from maintenance team leader to maintenance manager, then garden designer. She now leads garden design and soft landscaping projects. Her Moroccan-inspired design was one of five APL Avenue Show Gardens at BBC Gardeners’ World Live in 2019.
